title: Routine blood measures in CHARLS and ELSA: analysis code
description: Analysis code for incremental prediction of subsequent physician-diagnosis reports in CHARLS and ELSA. Includes paired laboratory comparisons, frozen cross-cohort transport, cross-fitted target recalibration, paired pipeline-refitting sensitivity analysis and figure rendering. No participant-level data, individual predictions or private fitted objects are included.
